mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_learn_progress (user_id, video_id, position, duration, speed, last_report_time, device_id, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.userId}, #{item.videoId}, #{item.position}, #{item.duration}, #{item.speed}, #{item.lastReportTime}, #{item.deviceId}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE position = VALUES(position), duration = VALUES(duration), speed = VALUES(speed), last_report_time = VALUES(last_report_time), device_id = VALUES(device_id), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT #{videoId} AS videoId, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS watchUv, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN position * 10 >= duration * 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finishCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN position * 10 < duration * 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bounceCount FROM t_learn_progress WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
